body:
Real-deploy finding: mounting with base_url=https://p23q.org/shopping/ half-works.
The SPA catch-all owns the whole domain (login page shows at /shopping but also
everywhere else), the router rewrites URLs to domain-root /login, assets/API are
absolute (/assets, /api/v1), and the landing/apk routes are hardcoded at the
root. Android is already prefix-correct (relative Retrofit paths), which means
the API must live under the prefix too.

Fix: derive root path from base_url's path; register webapp/landing/apk routes
under it; url_prefix default becomes {root}/api/v1 (explicit value wins); serve
index.html with the asset URLs rewritten and window.__APP_BASENAME__ injected;
web client reads the basename at runtime (router basename, API base, APK probe).
At root (empty path) everything stays byte-identical to today.
title: Blueprint must be fully mountable under a path prefix (p23q.org/shopping breaks)
